# @amykit/plugin-file-tasks

Tasks as a directory of files: written by `amy btw`, by an editor, or by a hook.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy). It provides the `tasks` port.

Use it with the errand workflow, which reads its work from the tasks port this plugin mounts. A task is a file in a directory, written by amy btw, by an editor or by a hook, and a task that names no repository is about the configured default.

## What it extends

|  |  |
| :-- | :-- |
| Ports | `tasks` |
| Actions | _none_ |
| Operations | _none_ |
| Commands | _none_ |
| Events | _none_ |
| Environment | _none_ |

## Install

```sh
amy add @amykit/plugin-file-tasks
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-file-tasks"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/plugin-file-tasks":
    directory: "tasks"
    repo: ""
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `directory` | `string` | no | `tasks` | where the tasks are kept, relative to the state directory |
| `repo` | `string` | no | `""` | what a task is about when it does not say |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.
